operations.details: Verified official OGC Coverage Implementation Schema 1.1 document.
Coverage model conformance separated from source-value accuracy.
Coverage encoding presence not promoted to terrain-source lineage.
CIS model alone rejected as vertical datum or accuracy evidence.
Verified official OGC Web Map Service standard page.
WMS display image separated from original numeric coverage.
Rendered PNG/JPEG pixel not promoted to DTM elevation sample.
Numeric-source equivalence required before any WMS-derived measurement.
CIS and WMS URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No coverage-model or map-image value substituted for parcel elevation.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
